data.summary: Once per battle for each unit with this ability: in your Shooting phase, as this unit is picked to shoot, you may use it, and its ranged attacks then have [INDIRECT FIRE] for the rest of that phase.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.durationBasis: core rule 01.02.02 Persisting Rules Effects: the card states no duration, so the effect lasts for the phase in which it was applied
